### First idea {#sec-{{IDL}}-theory-first}

Theory is written once, here, and included by both `slides.qmd` and
`handbook.qmd`. Use `###` headings: `slides.qmd` sets `slide-level: 3`, so each
one becomes a slide, and in the handbook they nest under "Theory".

All mathematics in LaTeX, with labelled display equations:

$$
y = a + b\,x
$$ {#eq-{{IDL}}-model}

::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"}
Material that belongs in the handbook but would not fit on a slide goes in a
block like this one — derivations, caveats, the second-order treatment. It is
still written once; only its audience differs.
:::

### Second idea {#sec-{{IDL}}-theory-second}

Keep each idea to one screen. If a section cannot be said in one slide, it is
two ideas.
